title: CBOR bignum content that fits an ECMA-404 number

source.note: composed: the one tag that is kept. A positive bignum is tag 2 over a byte string, and the codec resolves it to an integer before the message model sees it; 2^64-1 is the largest value ECMA-404 can still hold exactly, so it decodes to a number rather than being refused. The bytes are `{"$tag": [2, {"$bytes": "//////////8="}]}` through conformance/tools/cbor_encode.py — tag 2 over eight 0xff bytes.

notes: A bignum one bit larger has no ECMA-404 spelling and is refused rather than rounded into a float. The corpus does not pin that case, because the error it produces is a codec-level `cbor` failure whose boundary is the codec's, not the protocol's.
